abstract: AIM: Relatively small benign ovarian cysts are conservatively managed in early pregnancy. However, emergency surgery is required should acute abdomen occur. Our study aimed to examine and compare the outcomes of benign ovarian cysts treated with elective laparoscopic surgery or emergency surgery during pregnancy. METHODS: From 2004 to 2017, we treated 135 pregnant patients (110 elective and 25 emergencies) with benign ovarian cysts at our tertiary perinatal center and compared their surgical and perinatal outcomes. RESULTS: There was no significant difference in cyst diameter (7.6 ± 2.5 vs. 6.8 ± 2.1 cm), but cysts <6 cm were significantly more common in emergency (36%) than in elective (15%) cases. Mature teratomas were significantly more common in elective cases (89% vs. 52%) but corpus luteum cysts were more common in emergency cases (0% vs. 32%). The rates of laparoscopic surgery (98.2% vs. 52.0%) and ovarian conservation (99.1% vs. 80.0%) were significantly higher, and post-surgical hospitalization (4.6 ± 1.3 vs. 9.8 ± 10.5 days) was significantly shorter in elective than in emergency cases. There was no significant difference in the gestational age for delivery (38.9 ± 1.9 vs. 38.4 ± 2.7 weeks), preterm birth rate (12% vs. 20%), or birth weight (2939 ± 469 vs. 3019 ± 510 g). CONCLUSIONS: We cannot state that an emergency surgery during pregnancy is rarely required for small benign ovarian cysts. However, the surgical outcomes were significantly better for elective than for emergency surgery, with no difference in perinatal outcomes. If a benign ovarian cyst is found early in pregnancy, elective laparoscopic surgery may be considered with adequate informed consent.
abstract_ja:
目的：比較的小さな良性卵巣嚢胞は、妊娠初期には保存的に管理されることが多い。しかし、急性腹症が生じた場合には緊急手術が必要となる。本研究は、妊娠中の良性卵巣嚢胞に対して待機的腹腔鏡手術または緊急手術を施行した場合の転帰を検討し、比較することを目的とした。
方法：2004年から2017年の間に、当院の高次周産期センターにおいて、良性卵巣嚢胞を有する妊婦135例（待機的手術110例、緊急手術25例）を治療し、その手術および周産期の転帰を比較した。
結果：嚢胞径には有意差がみられなかった（7.6 ± 2.5 vs. 6.8 ± 2.1 cm）が、6 cm未満の嚢胞は緊急手術群（36%）で待機的手術群（15%）より有意に多かった。成熟奇形腫は待機的手術群で有意に多く（89% vs. 52%）、黄体嚢胞は緊急手術群で多かった（0% vs. 32%）。腹腔鏡手術の施行率（98.2% vs. 52.0%）と卵巣温存率（99.1% vs. 80.0%）は待機的手術群で有意に高く、術後入院期間（4.6 ± 1.3 vs. 9.8 ± 10.5日）は待機的手術群で有意に短かった。分娩時の在胎週数（38.9 ± 1.9 vs. 38.4 ± 2.7週）、早産率（12% vs. 20%）、出生体重（2939 ± 469 vs. 3019 ± 510 g）には有意差がみられなかった。
結論：妊娠中に小さな良性卵巣嚢胞に対して緊急手術が必要となることはまれであるとは言い切れない。しかし、手術の転帰は緊急手術より待機的手術で有意に良好であり、周産期の転帰には差がみられなかった。妊娠初期に良性卵巣嚢胞が発見された場合には、十分なインフォームドコンセントのもとで待機的腹腔鏡手術を検討してよい。
